name: Neutrl USD
oneLiner: NUSD is Neutrl's synthetic dollar backed by liquid stablecoins and delta-hedged OTC positions; 1:1 mint/redeem via USDC, USDT, or USDe.
collateral: Accountable currently shows reserves concentrated in liquid stablecoins, with smaller OTC aggregate and other hedged reserve assets; Neutrl describes NUSD as a fully collateralized synthetic dollar backed by delta-neutral strategies and other crypto assets
pegMechanism: Permissionless 1:1 minting via router against USDC, USDT, or USDe; redemptions are restricted to KYC/KYB-approved counterparties and served from AssetReserve liquidity, while peg support also comes from arbitrage incentives, delta hedging, and a liquid stablecoin buffer.

oracleRisk.summary: NUSD is minted 1:1 from admitted liquid assets and backed by a managed delta-neutral portfolio, not by user debt positions subject to oracle-triggered collateral liquidation.

branchApplicability.rationale: Neutrl documents permissionless 1:1 Router minting from USDC, USDT, or USDe, institutional custody and strategy deployment, and KYC-gated redemptions served by an AssetReserve buffer or queue. It does not document borrower-specific collateral ratios, debt health, or liquidatable collateral branches.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

reserves.name: JLP (Jupiter Perps LP token)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Jupiter Perpetuals protocol and liquidity providers

reserves.name: ETH collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Ethereum network native asset held in Neutrl reserves

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-07-20 Accountable type_split snapshot exposes six named reserve buckets and weights ($67.78M total): Stablecoin 62.1%, JLP 14.6%, OTC Aggregate 15.6%, Other 4.5%, Protocol Owned Liquidity 3.1%, and a residual ETH 0.01%. The OTC Aggregate weight drifted from the 2026-07-14 capture (10.6%) beyond the live-overlay tolerance, so the envelope is restated on the adapter's exact renamed identities and current weights; the accountable adapter refreshes weights at runtime. The source does not identify stablecoin constituents, OTC counterparties, JLP positions, or the composition and custody of the Other and Protocol Owned Liquidity buckets.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable type_split categories and weights captured 2026-07-20 from the issuer's live reserve API
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Stablecoin constituents, OTC counterparties, JLP underlying positions, and the composition and custody of the Other and Protocol Owned Liquidity categories are not disclosed in the reviewed snapshot.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: No constituent weights are available for a canonical dependency mapping.
The dashboard names the JLP category but does not expose the current underlying position or custody detail needed for a tracked dependency.
The dashboard reports an aggregate OTC category without identifying current counterparties, contracts, or settlement terms.
The dashboard does not disclose the asset classes or providers included in the Other category.
The dashboard names protocol-owned liquidity but does not expose pool identities, underlying assets, or custody details.
The residual ETH bucket is external cryptoasset collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: Neutrl reserve wallets and custodial accounts tracked by the Accountable dashboard

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The Accountable reserve dashboard tracks Neutrl's reserve wallets and category balances but does not name the custody providers, account segregation, insolvency treatment, or rehypothecation terms behind the Stablecoin, OTC, JLP, Other, and Protocol Owned Liquidity buckets.

mintAuthority.summary: NUSD is a synthetic delta-neutral dollar whose token grants MINTER_ROLE to Neutrl's StableMinter and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to a separate admin; mint is routed through Neutrl's Router.sol into AssetReserve/StableMinter, while redemption is KYC-gated.

controls.label: NUSD StableMinter MINTER_ROLE
controls.capDescription: NUSD is minted only by holders of MINTER_ROLE; in practice the Router.sol mint() flow pulls collateral into AssetReserve.sol and a Minter contract issues NUSD 1:1, with a maxMintPerBlock rate limit.

routeChecks.rateLimits: Mint enforces maxMintPerBlock to limit per-block issuance.
routeChecks.signingModel: Mint is permissionless via Router.sol; redemption is restricted to KYC/KYB-approved counterparties (asymmetric design).

controls.evidence: Ethereum role reads confirmed 0xFF0B98C0B1d8390b2A7cFFBCcd4e20bFcfb8191D holds MINTER_ROLE; Neutrl docs list it as StableMinter and describe Router.sol mint() routing collateral to AssetReserve.sol before StableMinter issues NUSD with a maxMintPerBlock cap. At block 25530540, StableMinter is a direct non-proxy contract owned by the token admin EOA, which can change its configured mint limit.

controls.label: NUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (token admin)
controls.capDescription: The NUSD token admin (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, with transferAdmin/acceptAdmin) can grant/revoke MINTER_ROLE and DENYLIST_MANAGER_ROLE, concentrating mint-authorization and denylist control in a single admin.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294779, eth_getCode(0x51De41ec06e779715d7FB71Ef83A736cFc903217) returned 0x (empty bytecode) — confirmed EOA. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) previously confirmed true for this address.

review.evidence: MINTER_ROLE is held by StableMinter 0xFF0B98C0B1d8390b2A7cFFBCcd4e20bFcfb8191D; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by 0x51De41ec06e779715d7FB71Ef83A736cFc903217, verified EOA by eth_getCode returning 0x. Rechecked at Ethereum block 25530540: both NUSD and StableMinter have empty ERC-1967 implementation slots, direct deployed bytecode, and owner() = 0x51De41ec06e779715d7FB71Ef83A736cFc903217. Mint logic is not proxy-upgradeable, while the admin can change StableMinter parameters or authorize a replacement minter.
